note: Pennsylvania has no general business personal property tax. Allegheny County levies a 7% hotel room rental tax through the Treasurer's Special Tax Division (Hotel Tax Account Application), but only secondary sources were found for its return due date.

items.description: Employers with employees working in or residing in Philadelphia withhold the city's Wage Tax and register through the Philadelphia Tax Center; all Wage Tax filings are made there.

items.title: File and deposit the Philadelphia Wage Tax
items.description: How often depends on the Wage Tax withheld each month: under $350 file quarterly (2026 dates: April 30, July 31, October 31 and February 1, 2027); $350 to under $16,000 monthly, about two to three weeks after the month ends; $16,000 or more semi-monthly or weekly. The city publishes each year's schedule. The employer withholding rate was not confirmed.

items.title: Submit W-2s and reconcile the Philadelphia Wage Tax
items.description: Employers submit W-2s to the city by the last day of February each year.
